examples.text: sabbaphāliphullā kho, ānanda, yamakasālā akālapupphehi. te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
so tattha sukkhāni c'eva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni gomayāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, mukhavātañ'ca dadeyya, na ca paṃsukena okireyya.

18306.meaning1: having sprinkled; having scattered; having strewn

examples.text: tassa heṭṭhābhāgaṃ sodhāpetvā pākāraparikkhepaṃ kārāpetvā vālukaṃ okirāpetvā dhajapaṭākaṃ ussāpetvā vanappatiṃ alaṅ'karitvā añjaliṃ karitvā, sace puttaṃ vā dhītaraṃ vā labheyyaṃ, tumhākaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ karissāmī'ti patthanaṃ katvā pakkāmi.

18307.meaning1: doused; showered; peppered; strafed (somebody with something)
18307.commentary: (SNa) sā issāpakatā sapattiṃ aṅgārakaṭāhena okirī'ti tassa kira rañño ekā nāṭakinī aṅgārakaṭāhaṃ samīpe ṭhapetvā gattato udakaṃ puñchati, pāṇinā ca sedaṃ karoti. rājā'pi tāya saddhiṃ kathañ'ca karoti, parituṭṭh'ākārañ'ca dasseti. aggamah'esī taṃ asahamānā issāpakatā hutvā acirapakkantassa rañño taṃ aṅgārakaṭāhaṃ gahetvā tassā upari aṅgāre okiri. sā taṃ kammaṃ katvā tādisaṃ'y'eva vipākaṃ paccanubhavituṃ petaloke nibbattā.

examples.text: sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … esā, bhikkhave, itthī kaliṅgassa rañño aggamah'esī ahosi. sā issāpakatā sapattiṃ aṅgārakaṭāhena okiri

18308.commentary: (SNa) okilinīvatthusmiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti sā kira aṅgāracitake nipannā vipphandamānā viparivattamānā paccati, tasmā uppakkā c'eva hoti uṇhena agginā pakkasarīrā, okilinī ca kilinnasarīrā, bindūni'ssā sarīrato paggharanti, okirinī ca aṅgārasamparikiṇṇā. tassā hi heṭṭhato'pi kiṃsukapupphavaṇṇā aṅgārā, ubhayapassesu'pi, ākāsato'pi'ssā upari patanti. tena vuttaṃ, uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ itthiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okiriniṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ. sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … esā, bhikkhave, itthī kaliṅgassa rañño aggamah'esī ahosi.

18309.meaning2: is bestrewn, covered (with); extends in various directions

18311.commentary: (SNa) okilinīvatthusmiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti sā kira aṅgāracitake nipannā vipphandamānā viparivattamānā paccati, tasmā uppakkā c'eva hoti uṇhena agginā pakkasarīrā, okilinī ca kilinnasarīrā, bindūni'ssā sarīrato paggharanti, okirinī ca aṅgārasamparikiṇṇā. tassā hi heṭṭhato'pi kiṃsukapupphavaṇṇā aṅgārā, ubhayapassesu'pi, ākāsato'pi'ssā upari patanti. tena vuttaṃ, uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ itthiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okiriniṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ. sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … esā, bhikkhave, itthī kaliṅgassa rañño aggamah'esī ahosi.

18312.construction:
ava + √kuṭ > koṭ + *i + mant + ka
okoṭimant + ka

examples.text: so ca hoti dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavh'ābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khañjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.

18313.meaning1: more deformed; more misshapen; more distorted
18313.construction:
ava + √kuṭ > koṭ + *i + mant + ka + tara
okoṭimaka + tara

examples.text: yathā yathā kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānam'indo nāmaṃ sāvesi, tathā tathā so yakkho dubbaṇṇataro c'eva ahosi okoṭimakataro ca. dubbaṇṇataro c'eva hutvā okoṭimakataro ca tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.

18314.commentary: (MNa) yo yāva gopphakā otāretvāva pārupati, tassa accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti… yo ek'aṃsaṃ katvā thanaṃ vivaritvā yāti, tassa'pi accukkaṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.

18316.commentary: (PVa) sattaṃ gahetvāna, okkantan'ti punappunan'ti kammasañcoditā sattā nisitadhāraṃ satthaṃ gahetvā punappunaṃ taṃ vaṇamukhaṃ avakantanti.

examples.text: tato satthaṃ gahetvāna, okkantanti punappunaṃ, khārena paripphositvā, okkantanti punappunaṃ.

18317.meaning1: cutting off; severing; sawing off (something with)

examples.text: oramattakassā'ti parittamattakassa. adhisallikhat'ev'āyan'ti ayaṃ samaṇo navanītaṃ pisanto viya padumanāḷasuttaṃ kakacena okkantanto viya atisallekhati, ativāyāmaṃ karoti.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… candaggāhaṃ sūriyaggāhaṃ sukkarāhucaritaṃ uḷuggahayuddhaṃ devadundubhissaraṃ okkanti ukkāpātaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā
katamā ca, bhikkhave, jāti? yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, jāti.

18322.construction:
ava + kam + ti + ika
okkanti + ika

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, moggallāna, yathāsaññissa te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati taṃ saññaṃ mā manas'ākāsi taṃ saññaṃ mā bahulam'akāsi
tatra vata maṃ bhayaṃ vā sārajjaṃ vā okkamissatī'ti nimittam'etaṃ, sāriputta, na samanupassāmi. etam'ahaṃ, sāriputta, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo labhanto vā tathāgataṃ dassanāya alabhanto vā tathāgataṃ dassanāya, labhanto vā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya alabhanto vā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya n'eva okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
evam'evaṃ te paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa
ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… sāmaññe anapekkhavanto sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

idh'āvuso satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ n'ānusikkhanti, yesañ'ca dhammānaṃ satthā pahānam'āha, te ca dhamme nappajahanti, bāhulikā ca honti, sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā, paviveke nikkhittadhurā

18329.meaning2: connected with going astray (or going down); or to be abandoned

examples.text: ime kho, kassapa, pañca okkamaniyā dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti aññassa ghar'ūpacāraṃ okkamantassa āpatti dukkaṭassa. paṭhamaṃ pādaṃ ummāraṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. dutiyaṃ pādaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
gāmaṃ paviseyyā'ti parikkhittassa gāmassa parikkhepaṃ atikkamantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. aparikkhittassa gāmassa upacāraṃ okkamantassa āpatti pācittiyassa.

18331.commentary: (ANa) kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamamānā'ti randhagavesitāya upārambhapariyesanavasena kāḷakadhammaṃ okkamamānā. apica duṭṭhacittena puggalaṃ ghaṭṭentā'pi taṃ kaṇhadhammaṃ attano dahantā'pi lābhasakkār'atthaṃ kathentā'pi kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamanti'y'eva.

examples.text: te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā abhidhammakathaṃ vedallakathaṃ kathentā kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamamānā na bujjhissanti.
uposath'aṅgāni adhiṭṭhāya alaṅ'katapaṭiyattaṃ sirigabbhaṃ pavisitvā sirisayane nipannā niddaṃ okkamamānā imaṃ supinaṃ addasa.
dukkhaṃ supati, dukkhaṃ paṭibujjhati, pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati, devatā na rakkhanti, asuci muccati. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṃ okkamayato.

18334.commentary: (DNa) okkamī'ti iminā c'assa okkantabhāvo pāḷiyaṃ dassito, na okkamanakkamo.

examples.text: tesaṃ rasapathaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyataṃ acchādesi, taṇhā ca tesaṃ okkami.

18335.grammar: masc, agent, from okkamati, irreg, trans (+acc)
18335.meaning1: who has fallen (asleep); who has entered
18335.notes: agent noun used verbally see Perniola §292

examples.text: abhijānām'ahaṃ, aggivessana, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapetvā dakkhiṇena passena sato sampajāno niddaṃ okkamitā'ti.

18336.commentary: (ADha) okkamitun'ti etaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattasaṅkhātaṃ niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ pavisituṃ tattha patiṭṭhātuṃ abhabbā.

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ. katamehi pañcahi?
ariyabhūmiṃ okkamituṃ asakkonto'pi taṃ kilesaṃ vikkhambhetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto'va gacchati. na kammaṭṭhānavippayuttena cittena pādaṃ uddharati.

18337.commentary: (VINa) puna gāmasīmaṃ okkamitvā'ti sace gocaragāmato puratthimāya disāya sen'āsanaṃ, ayañ'ca pacchimadisaṃ gato hoti, sen'āsanaṃ āgantvā sattamaṃ aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetuṃ asakkontena gāmasīmam'pi okkamitvā sabhāyaṃ vā yattha katthaci vā vasitvā cīvarappavattiṃ ñatvā pakkamituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti attho. evaṃ asakkontena tatth'eva ṭhitena paccuddharitabbaṃ, atirekacīvaraṭṭhāne ṭhassatī'ti.

examples.text: anāpatti, chārattaṃ vippavasati, ūnakachārattaṃ vippavasati, chārattaṃ vippavasitvā puna gāmasīmaṃ okkamitvā vasitvā pakkamati, anto chārattaṃ paccuddharati, vissajjeti, nassati, vinassati, ḍayhati, acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti, bhikkhusammutiyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
no h'etaṃ, bhante. viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, mātukucchismiṃ okkamitvā vokkamissatha, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ itthattāya abhinibbattissathā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

18338.meaning2: having fallen into, having come on

18339.meaning1: would have entered; would have come down (into)
18339.meaning2: would have entered; would have come down
18339.commentary: (DNa) na okkamissathā'ti pavisitvā pavattamānaṃ viya paṭisandhivasena na vattissatha.

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, mātukucchismiṃ na okkamissatha, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ mātukucchismiṃ samuccissathā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

18341.meaning2: makes go up; makes move away

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena rukkhamūlaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi

18343.meaning2: (also ukkalā) the inhabitants of the country Ukkala (modern day Orissa)

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ okkalā vayabhiññā ahetukavādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā, te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.

18344.meaning2: dragging down or away; roughly, forcibly
18344.commentary: (DNa) okkassa pasayhā'ti ettha okkassā'ti vā pasayhā'ti vā pasayh'ākārass'ev'etaṃ nāmaṃ. ukkassā'ti'pi paṭhan'ti. tattha okkassā'ti avakassitvā ākaḍḍhitvā.

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, vajjī yā tā kul'itthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okkassa pasayha vāsentī'ti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mah'esī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetu'kāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi, okkāmukhaṃ karakaṇḍaṃ hatthinikaṃ sinisūraṃ.

katamā ca, bhikkhave, okkācitavinītā parisā nopaṭipucchāvinītā? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatāpaṭisaṃyuttā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti.

katamā ca, bhikkhave, okkācitavinītā parisā nopaṭipucchāvinītā? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatāpaṭisaṃyuttā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti.

18350.meaning1: name of one of the sons of king Okkāka

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mah'esī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetu'kāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi, okkāmukhaṃ karakaṇḍaṃ hatthinikaṃ sinisūraṃ.
brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchā bhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udak'orohakā aggiparicārakā. te mataṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṃ nāma okkāmenti.
yo, bhikkhave, pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ okkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya, yo majjh'anhikasamayaṃ okkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya, yo sāy'anhasamayaṃ okkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya

18355.meaning1: (it) is seen; is perceived; is discerned; it appears (for)
18355.meaning2: is seen or known, is visible, appears
18355.commentary: (SNa) okkhāyatī'ti (paccakkhāyati) paññāyati pākaṭaṃ hoti. iti dvīsu'pi etesu saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā.

examples.text: samādhiṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha. samāhitassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyatī'ti.

18356.commentary: (MNa) okkhāyikā'ti heṭṭhā anupaviṭṭhā. tassa kira lohite chinne maṃse milāte akkhiāvāṭakā matthaluṅgaṃ āhacca aṭṭhaṃsu, ten'assa evarūpā akkhitārakā ahesuṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti, evam'ev'assu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

18357.meaning1: one hundred large pots; one hundred cauldrons (of food)

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ okkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya, yo majjh'anhikasamayaṃ okkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya, yo sāy'anhasamayaṃ okkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya
okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde.
okkhittacakkhu antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

18360.meaning2: with eyes cast down; with eyes under control

18361.meaning1: with downcast eyes; with lowered gaze

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde.
okkhittacakkhu antaraghare nisīdissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

18363.meaning1: with a lowered barrier; with barricades

examples.text: evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikhāsu okkhittapalighāsu nagar'ūpakārikāsu dīghāsi'vudhehi purisehi rakkhāpenti, seyyathā'pi tvaṃ eta'r'ahi sācariyako'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde yojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, dviyojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, tiyojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti

18370.meaning2: consisting of a small company; accompanied by a small (or no) company

examples.text: accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

vedanāsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā, samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.

18374.meaning1: (of the sun, a star or a planet) setting; descending

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… ukkāpāto bhavissati, disāḍāho bhavissati, bhūmicālo bhavissati, devadudrabhi bhavissati, candimasūriyanakkhattānaṃ uggamanaṃ ogamanaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ bhavissati
ogayh'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ sotaṃ, sabbapāpaṃ pavāhayiṃ, tisso vijjā ajjhagamiṃ, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.
kusumitasikharā ca pādapā, abhigajjant'iva mālut'eritā, kā tuyhaṃ rati bhavissati, yadi ekā vanam'ogahissasi.

siyā kho pana te, gahapati, evam'assa, na nakulamātā gahapatānī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā patigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharatī'ti.

18382.meaning1: bathing place; ford in a river
18382.commentary: (UDa) ogāhā'ti titthato. ogāhan'ti'pi pāḷi. (THIa) nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇan'ti hatthināgaṃ nadiyaṃ ogāhaṃ katvā ogayha tato uttiṇṇaṃ. ogayha m'uttiṇṇan'ti vā pāṭho. ma-kāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇaṃ, nadītīramhi addasaṃ.

chinn'aggāni c'eva tiṇāni khādati, obhagg'obhaggañ'c'assa sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti, āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivati, ogāhā c'assa uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti. ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharati.

18383.meaning2: plunges or enters into, absorbs in
18383.commentary: (DNa) ogāhe te thanūdaran'ti yathā so nāgo pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhitvā pivitvā aggasoṇḍamattaṃ paññāyamānaṃ katvā nimuggo sukhaṃ sātaṃ vindati, evaṃ kadā nu kho te than'ūdaraṃ thanavemajjhaṃ udarañ'ca otaritvā ahaṃ sukhaṃ sātaṃ paṭilabhissāmī'ti vadati.

examples.text: sīt'odakaṃ pokkharaṇiṃ, yuttaṃ kiñjakkhareṇunā, nāgo ghamm'ābhitatto'va, ogāhe te than'ūdaraṃ.

18385.meaning1: entering (into); plunging (into); going deep (into); getting immersed (in)

18387.meaning1: emerged from bathing; coming out of the river
18387.commentary: (THIa) nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇan'ti hatthināgaṃ nadiyaṃ ogāhaṃ katvā ogayha tato uttiṇṇaṃ. ogayha m'uttiṇṇan'ti vā pāṭho. ma-kāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇaṃ, nadītīramhi addasaṃ.

18388.meaning2: plunged or entered into, absorbed in

examples.text: gantvāna buddho nadikaṃ kakudhaṃ, acch'odakaṃ sāt'udakaṃ vippasannaṃ, ogāhi satthā akilantarūpo, tathāgato appaṭimo ca loke.

18389.meaning1: having submerged (in); having immersed (in); having plunged (into)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mahānāma, puriso sappikumbhaṃ vā telakumbhaṃ vā gambhīraṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhitvā bhindeyya.

18391.meaning1: having submerged; having immersed; having plunged (in)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gāmaṇi, puriso sappikumbhaṃ vā telakumbhaṃ vā gambhīre udakarahade ogāhetvā bhindeyya.
te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.

18392.meaning2: plunged or entered into, absorbed in

18396.commentary: (MNa) ogilitun'ti pucchāya dosaṃ datvā hāretuṃ asakkonto ogilituṃ anto pavesetuṃ na sakkhiti.

examples.text: imaṃ kho te, rājakumāra, samaṇo gotamo ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno n'eva sakkhiti uggilituṃ na sakkhiti ogilituṃ.

18397.synonym: abhipāruta, avanaddha, āvaṭa, onaddha, chādita, pāruta, pārūta, veṭhita

examples.text: na oguṇṭhito antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

18399.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone) with a head wrap
